html:
If you are wanting to find out what is home window tinting, we are the window tinting experts! Home window tinting is where you have tinted film applied to your home’s windows. There are many benefits to having your home’s windows tinted, depending on the tint you have installed. Below we list the different type of film we offer so you can determine what is the best home window tint for your needs and also how you can find out what does home window tinting cost.

Tint a Home specialises in home window tinting, has been providing tinting services in Australia for 40+ years and we are Australia’s most trusted window tinting network. Read on for information on the tints we offer so you can determine what is the best home window tint for you and how to find out what does home window tinting cost.

What Is The Best Home Window Tint?

What is the best home window tint for your home will depend on what your requirements and preferences are. Here are the home window tints we offer to help you determine what is the best home window tint for you:

  • Solar films
    These films help to reduce heat & glare and protect you, your family and your floorings & furniture from the damage caused by harmful UV rays. You can also choose films with lighter shades that don’t alter the appearance of your home
  • Privacy films
    These films provide daytime privacy whilst still allowing natural light into your home. Those on the outside can’t see in so you no longer need to use blinds to obscure the view.
  • Safety film
    Safety film is designed to keep your family safe as it is stronger than standard film and keeps shattered glass together which help to prevent injury if the glass is broken accidentally.
  • Security film
    Security film is 10 times stronger than standard film. Because it holds shattered glass together it slows access into your home.
  • Decorative film
    Decorative film is a great way to add an element of style to your home. You can customize designs and is fantastic to use for internal dividers.

What Does Home Window Tinting Cost?

To find out what does home window tinting cost, the best thing to do is to speak with our experts who will be able to give you a quote. Here are two ways you can get in touch with us to find out what does home window tinting cost:

  1. Over the phone – Our experienced and friendly customer service team can assist you with how to obtain a quote and can also help you to get in touch with your local window tinting experts so you can book in.
  2. In-person – We have stores located throughout Australia. If you head to one of our stores, our team will be able to provide you with a quote so you can find out what does home window tinting cost from your local window tinting team.

Speak To The Tinting Experts Today

Use our Store Finder to find your nearest store and speak with your local window tinting experts who will be able to help you determine what is the best home window tint for your needs and provide you with a quote so you can find out what does home window tinting cost.
